links.name: MainFocus
links.quote: This guideline describes when and how clinic staff should clean their hands in order to reduce the spread of infection between patients.

links.name: Users
links.quote: Physicians, nurses and medical assistants working in outpatient clinics.

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: Clinic staff should clean their hands with an alcohol-based hand rub before and after every patient contact.

links.name: Directive
links.quote: clean their hands with an alcohol-based hand rub before and after every patient contact

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: If hands are visibly soiled, staff should wash them with soap and water for at least 20 seconds instead of using hand rub.

links.name: Action
links.quote: wash them with soap and water for at least 20 seconds
